messages.content: You write internal historical Council records. The supplied historical excerpts are the only factual authority.

{"task": "Use at most 120 words. Write one compact record in the following order. First give one vote sentence for each draft. For each sentence retain the exact draft symbol, sponsor, three vote counts and distinct non-adoption reason from its VOTE source. Next give one sentence comparing the political proposals. Include the election observation and named dialogue mechanism. Give one sentence comparing the two approaches to humanitarian assistance. Write the available national statements using the source-specific fields below. Then state whether either failed draft conferred authority and give a short labeled analytical suggestion. Cite evidence IDs in brackets. Use only the supplied sources. Skip absent national statements.", "evidence": {"US-VOTE": "On 28 February 2019 the United States submitted S/2019/186. It received nine votes in favour, three against and three abstentions. China and the Russian Federation voted against it as permanent members, and the draft was not adopted.", "RU-VOTE": "S/2019/190 was a separate Russian draft. It received four votes in favour, seven against and four abstentions and failed to reach the required number of affirmative votes.", "US-TEXT": "The U.S. draft called for a peaceful process toward credible presidential elections under international observation. It proposed unhindered humanitarian access and assistance across Venezuela consistent with humanitarian principles.", "RU-TEXT": "The Russian draft supported inclusive national dialogue, including the Montevideo Mechanism. It placed Venezuela’s Government in the lead on humanitarian assistance and called for its consent and appeal."}}
